Can Switch 2 compete with the other consoles? The campaign mode runs at 30fps, and it retains an impressive amount of the COD Engine's features here. Multiplayer is a bigger point of contention though. We have cross-platform online play with PS5 and Xbox machines - and the good news is matches those with a 60fps target here. Input latency is an issue on Switch 2 though, and we've found controller inputs lag behind the PS5 results. Note: latency results in this video relate to multiplayer only.
